roles.title: Product Manager - Multiple Levels
roles.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; Toronto, ON

bullets: Own strategy and roadmap for your product area. Set the multi-year direction for how current and future products evolve and build the prioritized roadmap to get there.
Own specific goals and outcomes. You will be responsible for specific product outcomes and goals all designed to drive meaningful growth for the marketplace.
Own the unit economics for your product. Know the levers that drive your product’s growth and margin.
Partner deeply across Design, Data Science, Strategy & Analytics, Go-To-Market, Operations and Engineering. Earn trust across functions, lead without authority, and keep complex…
Communicate clearly at every altitude. Translate complex, technical topics for a wide range of audiences, from engineering partners to senior leadership.

roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Search Ranking
roles.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA

bullets: Develop and execute a strategy that takes our search experience to the next level via ranking algorithmic iterations.
Own a product roadmap for Search Ranking that is analytically grounded, clearly prioritized, and connected to business outcomes
Direct the analytical work of the pod — working alongside a dedicated strategy & analytics partner to identify novel opportunities, diagnose root causes of failure modes…
Determine the right sequencing of opportunities, including when to invest in technical/foundational work that unlocks future gains versus near-term order volume delivery
Define and refine the metrics that give the team a clear picture of Search Ranking performance and the retailer experience
